people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

translations.web: I am Yahweh, your God, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt. Open your mouth wide, and I will fill it.
translations.bsb: I am the LORD your God, who brought you up out of Egypt. Open wide your mouth, and I will fill it.

translations.asv: I am Jehovah thy God, Who brought thee up out of the land of Egypt: Open thy mouth wide, and I will fill it.
